subject.title: feat(ui): modernize the Control UI dashboard

question: Should the Control UI adopt a new first-party Nova theme and collapse the System Settings group by default as one bundled visual-refresh direction?
rationale: The change is technically separable, but it intentionally changes first-use discoverability, theme catalog scope, and the visual language across every existing theme; those are maintainers' product choices rather than correctness questions.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped refresh
options.body: Approve the Nova theme and navigation-default direction, conditional on fixing the type error and completing visible behavior proof.

options.title: Narrow the proposal
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that lands only the approved visual surface, such as theme support or Settings disclosure, while leaving the other design changes separate.

options.title: Keep the existing direction
options.body: Decline the bundled visual refresh if the added theme and default hidden System group do not fit the current Control UI product language.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped refresh
recommendation.body: Approve the Nova theme and navigation-default direction, conditional on fixing the type error and completing visible behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Available adjacent Control UI design-refresh history makes EnzeD the strongest available routing candidate, though exact current-main ownership needs confirmation.
